items.prompt: The ledger remembers the past. → the ledger's ___ of the past
Records are protected across years. → the ___ of records across years
Questions are answered in minutes. → the ___ of questions in minutes
items.hintAfterError: Aqui o verbo vira substantivo com -ing, sem mudar a raiz.

items.prompt: The institution remembers everything. → the ___ memory
items.hintAfterError: Antes de 'memory' é preciso um adjetivo: acrescente -al ao substantivo.

items.prompt: Entries are posted correctly. → the correct ___ of entries
The team works with discipline. → the ___ work of the team
items.hintAfterError: Antes de 'work' entra um adjetivo formado com -ed.

items.prompt: The history can be accessed at any time. → the constant ___ of the history
items.hintAfterError: Depois de 'the constant' e antes de 'of' é preciso um substantivo.

items.prompt: The corrections are documented carefully. → the careful ___ of corrections
The ledger drifts quietly. → the ___ drift of the ledger
items.hintAfterError: Antes de um substantivo ('drift') vai adjetivo, não advérbio em -ly.

items.prompt: Answers come quickly, not in weeks. → the ___ of the answers
